description: This file is a Perl script for generating package metadata, configuration, and dependency information for OpenWRT build system. It includes functions for version comparison, dependency resolution, and outputting package data in various formats such as JSON, makefile, and CycloneDX SBOM.

methods.name: version_to_num
methods.description: Converts a version string like '1.2.3' into a numeric value for comparison.

methods.name: version_filter_list
methods.description: Filters a list of version strings based on a comparison version.

methods.name: gen_kconfig_overrides
methods.description: Generates kernel config overrides based on package and build system configuration files.

methods.name: __find_package_dep
methods.description: Recursively checks if a package depends on a given package.

methods.name: find_package_dep
methods.description: Wrapper to avoid infinite recursion when checking package dependencies.

methods.name: package_depends
methods.description: Determines dependency relationship between two packages.

methods.name: mconf_depends
methods.description: Generates dependency configuration lines for package build options.

methods.name: mconf_conflicts
methods.description: Generates conflict configuration lines for packages.

methods.name: add_implicit_provides_conflicts
methods.description: Adds conflict entries for packages that provide the same virtual package.

methods.name: print_package_config_category
methods.description: Outputs configuration menu for a package category.

methods.name: print_package_overrides
methods.description: Outputs package override configuration.

methods.name: gen_package_config
methods.description: Generates the full package configuration in Kconfig format.

methods.name: and_condition
methods.description: Converts a logical AND condition into Kconfig syntax.

methods.name: gen_condition
methods.description: Converts a logical condition into Kconfig syntax.

methods.name: get_conditional_dep
methods.description: Wraps dependency string with conditionals based on build options.

methods.name: gen_package_mk
methods.description: Generates package makefile dependencies and build rules.

methods.name: gen_package_source
methods.description: Outputs source file information for packages.

methods.name: gen_package_auxiliary
methods.description: Outputs auxiliary package variables such as repository and dependencies.

methods.name: gen_package_license
methods.description: Outputs license information for packages.

methods.name: gen_version_filtered_list
methods.description: Outputs a filtered list of version strings.

methods.name: gen_usergroup_list
methods.description: Outputs user and group assignment list for packages.

methods.name: gen_package_manifest_json
methods.description: Outputs package metadata in JSON format.

methods.name: image_manifest_packages
methods.description: Parses image manifest file to list included packages.

methods.name: dump_cyclonedxsbom_json
methods.description: Creates a CycloneDX SBOM JSON document from components.

methods.name: gen_image_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates CycloneDX SBOM for image packages.

methods.name: gen_package_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates CycloneDX SBOM for package manifest.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and executes corresponding functions.
